pwf.pref.subtitle.text: Choose how many days before a deadline your tasks turn green, yellow and red, and your own reminder days. You can only be warned earlier than the official level, never later.
pwf.pref.links.label: Links of the screen
pwf.pref.levels.title: Your reminder levels
pwf.pref.card.title: Project task deadline reminders
pwf.pref.card.failed: Your deadline reminders could not be read.
pwf.pref.form.label: My deadline reminders
pwf.pref.readOnly.text: Read-only session: you can see the settings but not change them.
pwf.pref.rule.text: Leave a level empty to follow the official one. Your level may only be equal to or larger than the official level (earlier warning). Official alerts, escalation and KPI scores do not change with this setting.
pwf.pref.noSetting.text: You have not set a level of your own, so the official levels apply. Enter more days than the official level to be warned earlier.
pwf.pref.clamped.text: Your {levels} level is later than the official level now in force, so the official level is used instead. Choose a level equal to or earlier than the official one and save again.
pwf.pref.green.label: Green: up to (working days left)
pwf.pref.yellow.label: Yellow: up to (working days left)
pwf.pref.red.label: Red: up to (working days left)
pwf.pref.reminders.label: Your reminder days (days left)
pwf.pref.reminders.hint: Decreasing, at most {max}, for example 7, 3, 1; none below the official red level ({official}). Leave empty to follow the official reminders.
pwf.pref.personal.label: as you set it
pwf.pref.sentence.official.label: Official levels
pwf.pref.sentence.blocked.text: Put the levels in order to see how they work.
pwf.pref.sentence.same.text: You have not set a level of your own: the official levels apply.
pwf.pref.problem.range.error: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
pwf.pref.problem.orderGreen.error: The green level must be larger than the yellow level.
pwf.pref.problem.orderYellow.error: The yellow level must be larger than the red level.
pwf.pref.problem.notEarlier.error: Your level cannot be later than the official level ({official}). It may only be equal or earlier.
pwf.pref.problem.reminderOrder.error: Reminder days must decrease, each one once.
pwf.pref.problem.reminderNotEarlier.erro: A reminder day cannot be below the official red level ({official}).
pwf.pref.refusal.conflict.error: Somebody has just changed this setting. Load the newer version and try again.
pwf.pref.refusal.order.error: The levels are not in order: the days must decrease from green through yellow to red.
pwf.pref.refusal.notEarlier.error: A level is later than the official one. Your setting may only warn earlier or at the same time.
pwf.pref.refusal.denied.error: You may not set deadline reminders for yourself.
pwf.pref.refusal.validation.error: The setting is not valid. Check the numbers.
pwf.pref.refusal.general.error: The setting could not be saved. Try again later.
pwf.pref.preview.title: Colour by days left, preview
pwf.pref.preview.blocked.text: Put the levels in order (green above yellow, yellow above red) to see the preview.
pwf.pref.preview.examples.label: Colour at some numbers of days left, official and as you set it
pwf.pref.preview.days.label: Days left
pwf.pref.preview.official.label: Official colour
pwf.pref.check.unavailable.text: The server could not be asked; the table above is worked out on your device.
pwf.pref.check.differs.text: The server colours the days left differently from the table above at: {days}. Save and read again, or tell an administrator.
pwf.pref.check.formula: The server places each number of days left against your three levels: red when not above the red level, yellow when not above the yellow level, green when not above the green level, not yet in range when larger.
pwf.pref.check.source: Server preview in working days of a project task
pwf.pref.tasks.title: My coming tasks
pwf.pref.tasks.note.text: The real due date and the official colour are always shown. The colour as you set it appears only here and in notifications sent to you; the deadline board and the reports show the official colour only.
pwf.pref.tasks.project.label: Project
pwf.pref.tasks.task.label: Task
pwf.pref.tasks.status.label: Status
pwf.pref.tasks.due.label: Due
